sloka: न त्वं सुभ्रु समाधेया पतिशुश्रूषणं प्रति ।अवश्यं तु मया वाच्यमेष ते दैवतं परम् ।। ६.१२२.३६ ।।
transliteration: na tvaṁ subhru samādheyā patiśuśrūṣaṇaṁ prati ।avaśyaṁ tu mayā vācyameṣa te daivataṁ param ।। 6.122.36 ।।

translations.english: "Daughter! that which you have done is a sign of your character. It is highly difficult to do. You will overshadow the future of other women."
